{{Capricorn}}
Capricorn 20 is the 48th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 20th day of Capricorn, and it is a Saturday. It corresponds to ISO week 7, weekday 6.

Its informal Japanese name is 2宮20日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 48|Chapter 48]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152068}}.
